summary: You do not have to keep doing something the hard way simply because the old method still technically works.
body: You do not have to keep doing something the hard way simply because the old method still technically works. When Mars trines Uranus, a better tool, process, or approach can remove work you have been treating as unavoidable, often without compromising the result you actually care about. The useful insight may be embarrassingly simple: automate the repetitive part, change the route, use the better tool, or stop doing the step that no longer serves a purpose. If the new method gives you back time or energy without creating another problem, let your life get easier.
